text:
ana-ux: quick heads-up — running the samplekit onboarding flow hit a weird delta: tool-calls with a schema set to strict=false got coerced back to permissive mode after an auth retry.

mike-eng: ugh. log? repro steps?

ana-ux: (typo, meant ana-ux) attaching short repro: start request -> auth token 401 -> SDK auto-retry -> helper re-initializes schema with fallback. snippet:```js
const client = new SDK({ jsonMode: true, schema: myToolSchema, strictSchema: true });
await client.callTool('getUser', payload); // on 401 the retry path uses createHelper() without strict flag
```

priya-devex: that matches a report from a customer yesterday. their structured output ended up as a plain string array and fncall parsing failed.

mike-eng: might be parity bug between node and python helpers — node's helper reuses the original options but python re-instantiates from env defaults.

ana-ux: (sorry again) Is there a quick mitigation we can ship to sample apps while we fix the SDK? Maybe a lint/harness check that asserts strictSchema is preserved on retry.

mike-eng: I can push a tiny fix: ensure the retry wrapper threads through opts like `strictSchema` and `jsonMode`. Low-risk. Will add unit test to protect against regressions.

priya-devex: also add an integration test that runs the onboarding flow with simulated 401 on first try, asserts the final tool output is still validated (schema rejects extra fields).

ci-bot: pipeline failed on samplekit-e2e (flake) — re-run queued.

ana-ux: thanks — could we also add a developer note in docs about "retry re-instantiation" so DX folks don't reintroduce this? Short blurb under SDK helpers.

mike-eng: yep. I'll open PR with: fix + tests + docs blurb. tagging @pri-devex for review on test plan.

priya-devex: ack. will review tomorrow AM and coordinate a canary deploy to dedicated to ensure no perf regression. :thumbsup:
